# Plivex

> Plivex is a web-based GST billing and business management platform for Indian small businesses, retailers, wholesalers, distributors, freelancers, and service providers. A free account is available.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://plivex.in/): Product overview and account creation
- [About Plivex](https://plivex.in/about): Company and founder information
- [Features](https://plivex.in/features): Billing and business-management features
- [Pricing](https://plivex.in/pricing): Current plan and pricing information
- [Contact](https://plivex.in/contact-us): Contact and support options

## Product capabilities

Plivex supports GST and non-GST invoices, quotations, client management, expense tracking, stock tracking, and business reports. Refer to the live website for current feature availability and plan limits.
